expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Eliminates 'photorealistic renders' commodity language; reframes '2 rounds of revisions' as 'The Clarity Guarantee'; zero vendor-style language present; positions as communication system strategist.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: Opens with investor conviction objective: 'can they see exactly what they're funding?'; frames around moving from 'evaluation to commitment'; explicitly ties to capital-raise decision logic and investor psychology.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Explicitly strategic partner language: 'structure how your project is presented'; positions work as 'communication system designed to answer questions investors ask'; never sounds like production vendor.

Begins with investor conviction need, not deliverables; deliverables introduced as tools serving objective; pricing framed as investment in moving capital raise from 'maybe' to 'committed', not as production cost.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Explicitly approved: 'APPROVED FOR USE'; scorecard shows 5/5 across all dimensions; closes with slogan integration; tone is strategic partner briefing investor on communication strategy.
